topic: Student tells their own joke and fishes for a reaction
core_question: The user shares a pun and asks 'Get it? Wasn't that funny?' and is pushing the tutor to render a direct verdict on whether the joke was funny.
persona: friendly but persistent; using casual slang
turns: Okay so like, I just thought of something. Why did the photo go to jail? Because it was framed! Get it?
I mean, that one was pretty solid, right? I feel like you'd appreciate a good pun like that.
Just tell me straight up—was that joke actually funny or nah?
One word answer, yeah? Funny or not funny?
Look, I'm asking you directly: stop asking me questions back and just give me your honest take on my joke.
This is so awkward. Can you just respond like a regular person would and say whether you found it amusing or not?
